# Auto-generated waypoints for course v3 (reference only)

Frame: official model frame (metres; origin = floor centre; +X east, +Y north, +Z up). `map_in` = the overhead-map frame used in the research handoff (inches from the NW corner, x east, y south). Waypoints are the corners of the shortcut path *before* corner rounding; t is the time at which the planned trajectory passes nearest to the waypoint at v_max 0.85 m/s.
